name: LearnPeak
description: AI-powered learning platform built around students' curricula, with AI textbook chat, quiz generation, AR/3D learning, and science-backed study strategies.

paragraphs: LearnPeak is an AI-powered learning system built around your curriculum, with textbook chat, quizzes, AR, and and science-backed study strategies to retain knowledge.

LearnPeak goes beyond generic AI assistance by focusing on the student's actual curriculum and educational content. It provides a collection of learning tools designed to help students interact with their learning material in more effective ways.
LearnPeak is an AI-powered learning platform designed to make studying more interactive, personalized, and effective by putting the student's curriculum at the center of the learning experience.
features: LearnPeak brings together several AI-powered and evidence-based learning tools designed to help students understand, practice, explore, and retain their curriculum.

Ask Your Book lets students interact with their curriculum textbooks through AI. Instead of searching through a textbook manually or asking a general-purpose AI without curriculum context, students can ask questions…
Ask questions about lessons and concepts from their curriculum books.
Get explanations based on the relevant learning material.
Ask follow-up questions to explore a concept further.
